exposure: Serum glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) levels
outcome: Time to achieve full oral feeds
cohort: 145 neonates (61% male; 33% black) divided into three groups: (1) only seizures without HIE, (2) HIE with seizures, and (3) HIE without seizures.
finding: Neonatal seizures are an important feature that may worsen brain injury in neonates with HIE, even after therapeutic hypothermia, with higher Tau and NF-L levels relating to worse outcomes.
